overview_description.description:
Kopa is a marketplace for furnished rentals and compatible housemates to foster community and enhance personal and professional connections.

We believe that exploration and community make people whole. Kopa exists to inspire people to get out of their comfort zones, to form lasting relationships, and to live fuller lives.
